scope: Training-reader diagnostic and bounded search; no outer validation/test feature arrays or scores
hypothesis: Subject amplitude differences and PCA compression may hide transferable information; retain all 840 coordinates after log1p and per-word within-band centering
representation: For each complete word, sign(x)*log1p(abs(x)); this equals log1p for observed nonnegative TRT, and handles possible negative Gaussian draws without clipping. Subtract mean across 105 channels separately in each band; sentence coordinate mean across complete words. No PCA or target text as numeric input.
structural_preprocessing: Prior first 14 structural columns plus word-count basis rebuilt on fold-training counts; one training-fit median/standard transform shared across all structure-bearing arms
eeg_preprocessing: Word normalization is observation-local and label-independent; sentence median imputation and standard scaling fit fold-training observations only. Gaussian is drawn in original word space from fold-training word moments with exact masks/counts, then normalized identically.
folds: Leave each of eight original training readers out; fixed 300-class training candidate vocabulary; source outer val/test arrays are never extracted from cache
selection: Equal-reader mean Recall@1, ties within 1e-12 prefer zero/smaller EEG weight then larger alpha; same 9 alpha/weight candidates per combined head and condition
class_control: For structural_shuffled, consistently derange all training sentence-class targets; query targets stay correct. This is a whole-pair negative control, not an isolated block ablation.
interpretation: Known-class head predicts labels for seen sentence classes only; cannot establish unseen-text semantics. Structural-only is a separate non-EEG comparator.
gate: Before any future outer evaluation: selected structural_real must exceed selected structural_only and structural_gaussian by at least 0.02 macro Recall@1, with positive per-reader differences to both in at least six of eight readers. Descriptive screening only, not independent significance.
stopping: One frozen training-only run, report all settings and controls. Stop without outer validation or test evaluation; any additional confirmation requires a separately specified protocol.
duration_units: Source sample counts at 500 Hz, structural-only columns, no timing inferred
